records.groupTitle: Distribution Of Residents With Disabilities Aged 15 - 64 By Labour Force Status
records.title: Distribution Of Residents With Disabilities Aged 15 - 64 By Labour Force Status, Annual
records.footnote: Data for persons with disabilities aged 15 - 64 years pertain to the resident population (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) and are based on two-year moving average of distributions in June of reference years to smoothen out year-on-year fluctuations due to the relatively small number of persons with disabilities. For example, 2019 figure refers to the average of June 2018 and June 2019. The unemployed figures refer to the unemployed as a percentage of population. This is different from the unemployment rate, which is expressed as a percentage of the labour force.
